description: Reproduction of the facts from a real p-cresol diagnostic (peaks grabbed from an image; no real spectrum is used): one broad 3338 (read as phenol O-H, H-bonded O-H, primary and secondary amine N-H), 1618 and 1601 (read as aromatic C=C, amide I, alkene C=C), 1518 (nitro asymmetric), 1357 and 1299 (nitro symmetric), and EVERY peak at the same intensity y=85, so every peak counts as strong. The remaining peaks (3025, 2925, 1240, 1170, 815) are assumed p-cresol positions, not from the real file; no 1375 CH3 bend on purpose (it would switch off the alkyl-aromatic exception for the nitro pair). Synthetic.

ir.note: all peaks y=85 (flat intensity from an image trace)
